hooks.command: input=$(cat); if printf "%s" "$input" | grep -qi "git commit" && printf "%s" "$input" | grep -qiE "co-authored-by:[^<]*<[^>]*@"; then echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PreToolUse\",\"permissionDecision\":\"deny\",\"permissionDecisionReason\":\"This repo forbids Co-Authored-By trailers (AGENTS.md: single-line commit messages). Re-run the commit without the trailer.\"}}"; fi
